_doc: Explosions and shots. Airblast: Kingery-Bulmash curves for a hemispherical TNT surface burst as simplified by Swisdak, M. M., 'Simplified Kingery Airblast Calculations', 26th DoD Explosives Safety Seminar, Aug 1994 (DTIC ADA526744), F = exp(A + B ln Z + C ln2 Z + ...), Z = R / W^(1/3) in m/kg^(1/3), pressure in kPa, impulse in kPa-ms divided by W^(1/3); outside the Z range of the first/last row the value is that of the nearest end (DDESB TP 20, 11 Jun 2018, 2.4.3.2). Positive phase duration td (ms, times W^(1/3)) from the same Swisdak fits. A building answers to the load it feels: the peak pressure times min(1, td / response_ms) (an impulsive load shorter than the structure's own response is felt as a fraction of its peak, the pressure-impulse idea of UFC 3-340-02); response_ms is a design decision, not a measured or tabulated number: UFC 3-340-02 sorts a load as impulsive or quasi-static by comparing its duration with the natural period of the element, and low-rise masonry has no single period, so 0.1 s is taken as the order of a house wall; it only decides how much of the peak a short pulse counts for. Damage by overpressure: Glasstone & Dolan, The Effects of Nuclear Weapons, 3rd ed. 1977: 5.131 a two-storey brick house at 5 psi (34.5 kPa) is demolished; 5.132 light industrial buildings at 3 psi (20.7 kPa) suffer extensively; Fig 5.89 and 5.104 trucks overturned and utility poles collapsed at 5 psi; windows break at about 1 psi (6.9 kPa). People: Glasstone & Dolan table 12.38 (effective peak pressure): lethality threshold 40 psi (275.8 kPa), 50 percent 62 psi (427.5 kPa); eardrum rupture threshold 5 psi (34.5 kPa), 50 percent 15-20 psi (120.7 kPa); each is a log-normal probit through its two points (the pulses of that table are long, so small charges are judged on the safe side for the victim; DDESB TP 20 2.7.3 gives the short-pulse lung model and is kept in the research notes); noise: 140 dB re 20 uPa (200 Pa) is the threshold of pain. Design values with no published measurement (shot.*: the pistol of the reference game: head 100, trunk 34, limb 20 of 100 health, a limb comes off at 40 taken, the trunk opens at 3 hits, 12 hits burst a car), (behaviour of the 4.0 kept as reference, listed in the report): people.knock_* seconds down, panic_s and panic_gain (a walker breaks into a run), sever_chance, maim_chance, strike.hold_growth_s, fire_*, wear_gain. torn_kpa is the 100 percent lethality of table 12.38 (92 psi). Charge: design choice, strength S (1..50, the player's force) is W = charge_kg_per_s2 * S^2 kg of TNT (force 5 = 50 kg, force 50 = 5 t). Crater: pass_width_m is the widest vehicle allowed on Brazilian roads (CONTRAN Resolucao 210/2006, art. 1, item I: 2.60 m, https://www.legisweb.com.br/legislacao/?id=104243, opened): a crater that leaves a strip narrower than that cuts the road. Crater: the reference game's law (the owner's order: the lab, src/actionsWiring.ts explodeAt and render/playEffects.ts explode, is the reference), linear in the force: the hole is dug fireball_share (0.5) of the blow's fireball radius (tuning strike.scar_radius_m + scar_radius_per_force x S, 2.5 + 1.1 S m), depth_m plus depth_per_force_m a unit of force deep (0.6 + 0.12 S m), into the terrain on bare earth only; its mark is drawn 0.75 fireball radii out (render/effects/marks.h CRATER_SCALE). It replaced the earlier law (radius k W^(1/3), OSTI 6538779; depth the diameter over 7, OSTI 4833696), which gave 3.7 m at force 5 and 15.9 m at force 45 where the reference game digs 4.0 m and 26.0 m and draws 6.0 m and 38.9 m. vehicle_box_m: the top of the box a round meets, by VehicleType: the body's drawn height (render/agents.json) and, for a two-wheeler, its rider's head, the head and helmet standing 0.39 m over the shoulders (motorbike: shoulders 1.36 + 0.39 = 1.75; bicycle: shoulders 1.50 + 0.39 = 1.89).
